system.description:
[Trigger: Refer]: Use this effect after you have made a non-[Mob] enemy [Incapacitated] or [Dead]. You gain a +6 bonus to [Recovery]. This effect lasts until the end of the scene.

A jet-black scythe said to reap life. Defeating an enemy causes them to tremble with glee, transmuting their vitality into healing power.

Ancient Skull [Core Material] (40G) + Battle Ax (90G) + Long Spear (80G) + [Magic Catalyst 3] (25G) + Crafting Cost (85G)
